bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
old=create-videobot:before-duplicate-guard-87ee908e
new=create-videobot:duplicate-guard-87ee908e-stage
test -n "$(docker images -q "$old")" && test -n "$(docker images -q "$new")" || exit 60
for img in "$old" "$new";do
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs || exit 61
 docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$img" --check /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs || exit 62
done
set +e
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot "$old" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs > /tmp/dup-guard-baseline-87ee.log 2>&1
a=$?
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs > /tmp/dup-guard-candidate-87ee.log 2>&1
b=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,sys
a=Path('/tmp/dup-guard-baseline-87ee.log').read_text()
b=Path('/tmp/dup-guard-candidate-87ee.log').read_text()
def fail(x):
 return set(re.findall(r'(?m)^not ok \d+ - ([^\n]+)$',x))
if '# tests ' not in a or '# tests ' not in b:sys.exit(63)
if fail(b)-fail(a):sys.exit(64)
if len(fail(b))>len(fail(a)):sys.exit(65)
print('DUPLICATE_GUARD_NO_NEW_LIVE_TEST_FAILURES=PASS')
PY
test "$(docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 66
echo 'LIVE_CONTAINER_UNCHANGED=PASS'
